skills.name: Succor and Smite
skills.desc:
Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack repeatedly or hold it down to consume Melody and perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG. While Melody is not depleted, the Energy Regen is increased by {0} when Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance deals damage.
Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 4 applies 1 stack of Havoc Bane to the targets hit.

Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack repeatedly or hold it down to consume Melody and perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG. While Melody is not depleted, the Energy Regen is increased by {1} when Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance deals damage.
Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 4 applies 1 stack of Havoc Bane to the targets hit.

Mid-air Attack - Azure Sword Stance
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, consuming Melody and dealing Havoc DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tapping PC=Pressing Gamepad=Pressing} Normal Attack within a short time after casting this skill triggers Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 2.

Mid-air Attack - Feather Sword Stance
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, consuming Melody and dealing Havoc DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tapping PC=Pressing Gamepad=Pressing} Normal Attack within a short time after casting this skill triggers Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Azure Sword Stance
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tapping PC=Pressing Gamepad=Pressing} Normal Attack within a short time after a successful Dodge consumes Melody to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tapping PC=Pressing Gamepad=Pressing} Normal Attack within a short time after casting this skill triggers Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 3.
Casting Dodge Counter - Azure Sword Stance counts as casting Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Feather Sword Stance
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tapping PC=Pressing Gamepad=Pressing} Normal Attack within a short time after a successful Dodge consumes Melody to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tapping PC=Pressing Gamepad=Pressing} Normal Attack within a short time after casting this skill triggers Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 3.
Casting Dodge Counter - Feather Sword Stance counts as casting Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 2.

skills.name: Feather's Edge
skills.desc:
Sword Stance Switch
While in Azure Sword Stance, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill to switch to Feather Sword Stance and perform Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 1, dealing Havoc DMG.

While in Feather Sword Stance, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill to switch to Azure Sword Stance and perform Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 1, dealing Havoc DMG.

Sword Stance Switch: Azure
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Skill within a short time after casting Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance to switch to Azure Sword Stance and cast Sword Stance Switch: Azure, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
A successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes {0} Melody.
After casting this skill, the Basic Attack cycle will not reset for a short time.

Sword Stance Switch: Feather
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Skill within a short time after casting Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance to switch to Feather Sword Stance and cast Sword Stance Switch: Feather, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
A successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes {1} Melody.
After casting this skill, the Basic Attack cycle will not reset for a short time.

skills.name: Hush of a Thousand Voices
skills.desc:
Hush of a Thousand Voices
Consume all Melody to deal Havoc DMG and restore {0} point of Azure Plume. This DMG is considered Heavy Attack DMG.

Upon casting this skill, obtain Voice upon Voice. When casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, summon Shadow of Xuanling to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Voice upon Voice cannot stack. Once Shadow of Xuanling is summoned, the Voice upon Voice state is removed.

skills.name: The Way of Ten Thousand Voices
skills.desc:
Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure
Yangyang: Xuanling is in Azure Sword Stance by default. When Melody is depleted while in Feather Sword Stance, Resonance Skill - Feather's Edge is replaced by Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Skill to switch to  Azure Sword Stance and cast Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, dealing Havoc DMG and restoring {0} {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of Melody and {1} {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} of Azure Plume. This instance of DMG is considered Heavy Attack DMG.
When Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure hits the target, consume {2} {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of Havoc Bane on the target.
The Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance cycle is not reset within a short time after casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure. If casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure resets the cycle, summon a Wraith of Sound to finish the current attack and deal a fixed instance of Havoc DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG, which is not affected by any DMG Bonus effects and does not inflict Havoc Bane.
Successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes {3} {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=3} of Melody.

Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather
When Melody is depleted while in Azure Sword Stance, Resonance Skill - Feather's Edge is replaced by Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Skill to switch to Feather Sword Stance and cast Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, dealing Havoc DMG and restoring {4} {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=4} of Melody and {5} {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=5} of Azure Plume. This instance of DMG is considered Heavy Attack DMG.
When Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather hits, consume {6} {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=6} of Havoc Bane on the target.
The Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance cycle is not reset within a short time after casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather. If casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather resets the cycle, summon a Wraith of Sound to finish the current attack and deal a fixed instance of Havoc DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG, which is not affected by any DMG Bonus effects and does not inflict Havoc Bane.
Successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes {7} {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=7} of Melody.

Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance
When Azure Plume is restored to its maximum while in Azure Sword Stance, hold Normal Attack to consume STA and all Azure Plume to cast Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, generating a massive cyclone that strikes the area in front, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
When casting Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, gain Bated Breath: If Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the field, the Crit. DMG of this Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance increases by {9}. When Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance ends, Bated Breath is removed. Bated Breath can be gained up to once every {10}s.
Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance applies {11} stacks of Havoc Bane to the targets hit.

Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance
When Azure Plume is restored to its maximum while in Feather Sword Stance, if Yangyang: Xuanling is on the ground and not in a Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom cycle, hold Normal Attack to consume STA and cast Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, dealing Havoc DMG. After it hits a target, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall is automatically cast.
When casting Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, gain Streaming Storm, which lasts {12}s. While Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the team, the Crit. DMG of this Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance or the next Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, or Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom is increased by {13}. Streaming Storm is removed when Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom Stage 3 or Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom Stage 3 ends. Streaming Storm can be gained up to once every {14}s.
Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance applies {15} {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=A} stacks of Havoc Bane to the targets hit.

Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall
When Azure Plume is restored to its maximum while in Feather Sword Stance and airborne,  Mid-air Attack - Feather Sword Stance is replaced by Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack to consume STA and all Azure Plume to cast Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG. Casting Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall enters Hark the Wind for {16}s.

Hark the Wind
While in Feather Sword Stance, Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance is replaced by Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, which performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom Stage 2 and Stage 3 can be cast in mid-air close to the ground. Casting Stage 3 ends Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom. This attack cycle cannot be reset.
During Hark the Wind, a Dodge Counter counts towards the Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom cycle.

Feathered Oath
When nearby Resonators in the team inflict Havoc Bane on a target, Yangyang: Xuanling gains 1 stack of Feathered Oath for {17}s. Feathered Oath can be gained once every {18}s, stacking up to {19} times. While Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the team, each stack increases the Crit. DMG of Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, and Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom by {20}, up to {21}.

Refrain
Before Yangyang: Xuanling's Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 4, Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 4, Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, or Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance hits a target, record and propagate the highest stack count of Havoc Bane on targets within a certain range to all targets within range.

Melody
Melody has a maximum of {22} points.
Casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather restores {23} points of Melody.
Casting Resonance Liberation Hush of a Thousand Voices consumes all Melody.
Normal Attacks consumes Melody upon dealing damage.
Successful Dodge can be triggered during the action of Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Azure, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Feather, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather within a certain time of casting these skills, which consumes {24} {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=B} of Melody.

Azure Plume
Azure Plume has a maximum of {25} points.
Casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure,  Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, or Intro Skill - Skybound Feather restores {26} {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=C} of Azure Plume.
Casting Resonance Liberation - Hush of a Thousand Voices restores {27} {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=D} of Azure Plume.
Casting Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance or Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall consumes all Azure Plume.
